metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-85880: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.. Product: Windows
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-85880" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-85880" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-85880" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-ENDPOINT-008
